data.description:
**Second Map Out Now with Halloween Crazy Mode, New Demon Abilities and more**

# 👻 Solo/Multiplayer Horror Survival in Haunted Mansion
Horror Simulator is a thrilling multiplayer horror game that combines survival horror and strategic gameplay. Demons lurk within mansion, terrorizing countless victims. Legends suggest knowing a demon's name grants control over it. Brave souls like you must form a team of exorcists, delve deep into the shadow, face your fears and uncover the demon's name for rich rewards. 
{1927345324354897}

# 🕸 Immersive Horror Experience
Hunt various demons representing the seven deadly sins.

Use 7 sacramentals, solve challenging puzzles and reveal each sin. Perfect for horror fans seeking strategic depth.

Solo or 3-player co-op with real-time voice chat for seamless social experiences. Friendlist invite makes social hangout easier. 
{1204850563982022}

# 😱 Enter if you dare
Demons will do everything to scare you off, or even kill you. Once your sanity runs out, demons will initiate hunt mode. Escape and survive monster madness and find out the demon's name before your sanity drained.

Real-time voice chat lets you strategize and improve your chances of survival. In ghost mode, your role-playing continues as you guide surviving teammates through voice or items.


# 🙀 Shop System
Complete your tasks in each horror-filled run to earn coins which let you buy masks and in-game items.
